sloka: महोदरस्तु सङ्क्रुद्धः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः।चिच्छेद पाणिपादोरून् वानराणां महाहवे ।। ६.९८.९ ।।
transliteration: mahodarastu saṅkruddhaḥ śaraiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ।ciccheda pāṇipādorūn vānarāṇāṁ mahāhave ।। 6.98.9 ।।

translations.english: In that great war, enraged Mahodara with arrows decked in gold shattered the Vanaras by attacking on hands, legs, and thighs.
